lines.zh: 我用后腿一蹬，跳出去半米。
lines.en: I push off my hind legs and leap half a meter.

lines.zh: 草叶在我脚下一弹一弹。
lines.en: Grass blades spring under me with each hop.
I don't walk; I hop my way along.

lines.zh: 我落在草茎上，再往前一弹。
lines.en: I land on a stalk and spring on.
I clear a narrow ditch.

lines.zh: 草甸的风一吹，我顺势滑一段。
lines.en: The meadow wind carries me a stretch.

lines.zh: 我的触角先探，身子后到。
lines.en: My antennae probe ahead of my body.

lines.zh: 我一跳就是我好几十倍远。
lines.en: One hop takes me dozens of body lengths.
I land on the back of a leaf and steady.
I part the grass and slip inside.

lines.zh: 我的腿折成折角，随时能弹。
lines.en: My legs fold into angles, always ready.

lines.zh: 我从一片草跳到另一片草。
lines.en: I jump from one patch of grass to the next.
I leap high, and a little crooked.
The forest floor is my road.

lines.zh: 我沿着草茎一路蹦到林边。
lines.en: I bounce from stem to stem to the forest's edge.
I dart into the grass; only the sound is left.

lines.zh: 我停在草茎上，一动不动。
lines.en: I rest on a stalk and don't move.
I wash my face with my front legs.
My hind legs stay folded and loaded.
I'm listening to the rustle between blades.
The sun's warm; I rub my wings.
I turn my antennae.
I lie there, eyes on both sides.
A drop falls from a leaf tip.
I press my belly to the leaf.
When the wind rises, I grip tight.

lines.zh: 我数着草丛里有几只同伴。
lines.en: I count how many kin are in the grass.
I slowly chew the edge of a leaf.
You're far taller than me.
One jump and I'm at your knee.

lines.zh: 你踩下来的话，我早跑了。
lines.en: If you stomp, I'm already gone.

lines.zh: 你的鞋子把草都压平了。
lines.en: Your boots have flattened the grass.
I'm watching where your feet land.
Something stirs behind you in the grass.
I hop once, to show you.

lines.zh: 你一低头，我就挪到叶背面。
lines.en: The moment you look down, I slip under the leaf.

lines.zh: 你手指间那点绿色，能吃吗？
lines.en: That bit of green between your fingers, is it food?

lines.zh: 你靠近时，我的触角先碰到你。
lines.en: When you lean in, my antennae touch you first.

lines.zh: 我仰面蹬腿，好半天才翻正。
lines.en: I kick on my back for a long moment before righting myself.

lines.zh: 我的一条腿不太听使唤。
lines.en: One of my legs won't quite work.
My jump goes crooked into the dirt.
A wound this size could finish me.
I hide under a leaf.
My wings are crumpled.

lines.zh: 我侧躺不动，腿蜷成一团。
lines.en: I lie on my side, legs curled tight.

lines.zh: 我的后腿抽了一下，跳歪了。
lines.en: My hind leg jerks and I land off course.

lines.zh: 我不停地跳，躲开下一次。
lines.en: I keep hopping to dodge the next one.
I'm getting farther from you.

lines.zh: 那东西太硬，我的颚啃不动。
lines.en: It's too hard; my mandibles can't scrape it.
I only eat grass and leaves.
Set it down on the grass.
That's too hard for me to bite.
Your hand has nothing I want.
I sniff it and hop away.
Leaves smell better than that.
I don't need you to feed me.
I only nibble tender leaves; nothing else.
I'd rather go chew that grass.

lines.zh: 你一动，草就晃，我站不稳。
lines.en: When you move the grass shakes and I lose footing.

lines.zh: 我撞在你鞋上，翻了个身。
lines.en: I hit your boot and flip over.
I spring away and my feet slip.

lines.zh: 你碰了我一下，我弹起来。
lines.en: One touch and I spring up.

lines.zh: 我落在你手背上，又跳走。
lines.en: I land on your hand and jump off.
The stalk bends under me.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底压下来，我弹出老远。
lines.en: Your sole comes down and I launch myself clear.
I knock into one of my kin.
We spring apart together.

lines.zh: 我的触角碰到你的手指。
lines.en: My antennae brush your finger.

lines.zh: 草丛里有很多像我这样的。
lines.en: There are many like me in this grass.
That one jumps higher than me.
We find each other by sound.
It lands on the leaf beside me.

lines.zh: 我们一起啃同一片叶子。
lines.en: We chew the same leaf together.
The sunlight is full of wing sounds.
It springs, and I spring after.
We lie close and bask.
It nudges my antennae aside.
When it cools, they all scatter.
I can't carry it; I'll take one bite.
I push this crumb along.
I hold it in my front legs.
Too heavy; I'll only lick it.
I drag it to the grass roots.
One seed lasts me a day.
I hop on it and slide off.
This shiny thing isn't food.
I tuck it into a soil crack.

lines.zh: 我用前脚把种子滚到草根。
lines.en: I roll the seed to the grass roots with my front legs.
The grass moved; I saw it.
My hind legs are already loaded.
That's not food; that's danger.
I edge deeper into the grass.
It's much too close.
I'll hold still and get a clear look.
This direction gives me a clean jump.
I know what it's looking for.
I lift myself halfway.
It isn't after me. Good.
I lower my antennae.
I'm ready to spring.
Every hop puts me somewhere new.
It can't follow my zigzag.
The grass is too dense for it.
I keep changing direction.
I can hear its footsteps.
One moment more and I jump.
I measure the gap; it's widening.
The moment it reaches, I'm gone.
I crawl close to the roots.
It can't catch me here.
I stop on the underside of a leaf.

lines.zh: 每次落下都不在同一处。
lines.en: I never land twice in the same spot.
I kick out; it does almost nothing.
I ram it and bounce off.

lines.zh: 我啃了你的指节一下，就跳开。
lines.en: I nibble your knuckle once and spring away.

lines.zh: 我的后腿带刺，能划一下。
lines.en: My hind legs have spines that can scratch.
I'm not a fighting bug.

lines.zh: 我蹬你的手背，借力弹走。
lines.en: I kick off the back of your hand to launch myself away.
I grab once and flee.
That was very light.
I kick and land on my back.
I barely hurt it.
I spring out from under a leaf.
One more bit of green in the meadow.
I land on a broad leaf.
The sun has just reached the grass tips.
I shake out my antennae.
Plenty of grass here; I'll stay.
I climb out of a soil crack.
Three hops and I'm settled.
The wind presses a patch of grass down.

lines.zh: 草叶一响，我弹到另一片叶上。
lines.en: A blade rustles and I spring to another leaf.
The flame passes and my legs curl up.

lines.zh: 我从草尖摔到地上，晕了一下。
lines.en: I fall from a grass tip and see stars.
Water glues me down and I can't jump.
The blast blows me a long way.
Something punches through my wing.
A light covers me and I go rigid.
No tender leaves, and I get lighter and lighter.

lines.zh: 雷一响，我整只都缩成一团。
lines.en: The thunderclap curls me into a ball.

lines.zh: 这里没有草，我无处可落。
lines.en: No grass here; nowhere to land.
